newsitem.title: USA: USDA outlines CRP land and expiration dates.
newsitem.headline: USDA outlines CRP land and expiration dates.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Thursday that 21.5 million acres of land was under Conservation Reserve contracts due to expire this year.

The figure was the most precise accounting yet of Conservation Reserve Program acreage. Contracts expiring this year included 1,687,884 acres originally due to expire in 1995 and 11,568,734 acres originally to expire in 1996.
The remainder, 8,245,398 acres were enrolled under contracts expiring this year.
USDA said its figures took into account land withdrawn under "early out" provisions, expirations and terminations.
